title: Humidity-resistant perovskite solar cells via 2D capping layers
subject: Energy Materials
abstract: We report a scalable 2D capping strategy that improves the operational stability of perovskite solar cells under 85% relative humidity, retaining 94% of initial efficiency after 1000 hours.

title: Machine-learning screening of high-entropy alloys for hydrogen storage
subject: Computational Materials
abstract: This review surveys machine-learning approaches for screening high-entropy alloy compositions for reversible hydrogen storage, and benchmarks descriptor sets across four open datasets.
keywords: machine learning, high-entropy alloys, hydrogen storage

title: Point-of-care biosensor patch for continuous lactate monitoring
subject: Biomaterials
abstract: A skin-conformal microneedle patch enables continuous lactate monitoring in sweat with clinical-grade accuracy over 48 hours.

title: Circular design rules for fibre-reinforced polymer composites
subject: Polymers
abstract: We propose and validate design rules that allow fibre-reinforced composites to be mechanically separated and re-formed over five reuse cycles with under 8% property loss.
